{{Quote|I think your period of service is over, my young Jedi.''"<br />"''You mean&hellip;I am to be knighted?''"<br />"''That is precisely what I mean. I have met with the Council and they agree that you are ready.|[[Valenthyne Farfalla]], as he knights Padawan [[Johun Othone]]|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>}}
The '''Knighting Ceremony''' was the ceremony in which a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] or apprentice was made into a full [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. An ancient ritual, it was presided over by members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] or of the other three [[Jedi Council/Legends|Councils]] and led by the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]]. This ceremony could be repeated for a Knight who achieved the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]].

==Overview==
===Old Jedi Order===
{{Quote|You will forever look back on this day as one of great joy, but also one of great sorrow. It will help you to remember that, in life, the two are often closely linked.|Valenthyne Farfalla|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />}}
The Knighting ceremony was an ancient ritual dating back to the beginnings of the Order's history and each Padawan was responsible for preparing themselves and reviewing their role in the ancient rite. Only the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] could promote an apprentice to the rank of Knight by the end of the Republic, though in the past the student's master was also permitted to knight their own students. After passing the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]], the student was assigned a date that the ceremony was set to take place on. The day before the ceremony the Padawan was required to ascend to the heart of the [[Temple Spire/Legends|Tranquillity Spire]], where they were to [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] within the preparation chamber located there. While typically alone, it wasn't unheard of for several Padawans to meet there at once, though socializing was frowned upon as each apprentice was supposed to be searching for their future path.<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

[[File:Kinect_knighting.png|thumb|200px|[[Mavra Zane]]'s unorthodox knighting of her Padawan learners.]]
The following day, the Padawan was summoned to the next level of the Tower: the [[Hall of Knighthood/Legends|Hall of Knighthood]]. Entering into the darkened chamber, the Padawan would kneel in the center of the room as the Masters present ignited their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in a ring around the student. Led by the Grand Master of the Order, the other Masters were typically those who sat on the High Council and other prominent Jedi who helped in the apprentice's journey. If the High Council was unavailable, members of the other three [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]] could step in to complete the ring. Reciting the ancient passages used in the traditional ceremony, the Grand Master would lower their lightsaber to just above each of the Padawan's shoulders and, for those of hair-growing species, sever the [[Padawan braid/Legends|braid]] that hung behind the ear of the newly appointed Knight. The Jedi was then able to collect the braid and depart the chamber in silence, the ritual completed.<ref name="TJP" />

While the ceremony was the norm, sometimes expedience overrode tradition. During times of war or on extended journey missions, Masters would knight their own students if they could not return to the Temple or field promotions were necessitated by another ranking military personnel's death.<ref name="TJP" />

In addition to raising a Padawan to Knighthood, the Council also brought Knights to the Hall to grant them the rank of Master. To achieve this rank, a Knight could opt to take a modified version of the Trials, or successfully train a Padawan to Knighthood themselves.<ref name="TJP" />

Darth Vader performed a Sith version of the ceremony on his [[Galen Marek|secret apprentice]] just before [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|sending the young man to hunt]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]].<ref>[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

==New Jedi Order==
{{Quote|Jaden, you handed yourself exceptionally well on Vjun. To confront three Dark Jedi and defeat them took bravery and skill. For your efforts, I feel that you are ready to join our ranks as a Jedi Knight.|[[Jaden Korr]]'s knighting, by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|audio=JadenKnighting.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>}}
Following the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the exiled Grand Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] trained the last Jedi of the Old Order, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Because Yoda died before Skywalker completed his training, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] never was formally knighted and thus did not initially continue the rite in his resurrected [[New Jedi Order|Order]].<ref name="TJP" /> Beginning a new [[Jedi Praxeum|praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Skywalker trained several classes of apprentices, pronouncing them Knights once they had completed a battery of tests and completed their own lightsabers. Without ceremony, the practice of raising students often took place in casual conversation or during an informal gathering,<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref> as was the case with [[Jaden Korr]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

It wasn't until [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]] that Skywalker came to possess the last remaining copy of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', a guidebook from the Old Order that outlined the knighting ceremony. Working towards formalizing a ceremony that would fit his new Order, Skywalker performed the knighting of [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Zekk]], [[Tenel Ka Djo]], [[Lusa]], [[Raynar Thul]], and [[Lowbacca]] following their year of service in aiding the downfall of the [[Diversity Alliance]] and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. More celebratory than the rituals of the past, the ceremony was held in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple's]] [[Grand Audience Chamber]] before the entire Order. Incorporating a lightsaber salute from all ranking members of the Order, Master [[Tionne Solusar|Tionne]] performed a ballad of the deeds of the newly promoted Knights.<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: The Emperor's Plague">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Emperor's Plague]]''</ref>

[[27 ABY/Legends|Three years later]], as the first act of the reformed [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|High Council]], Skywalker [[Knightings on Dac|knighted]] the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] survivors of the [[Mission to Myrkr|Mission]] to [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] at a ceremony on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Each student was called individually to be given a brief and private speech by Skywalker, and then received their formal robes of Knighthood.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>

Following the horrors of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Temple on Coruscant was [[New Jedi Temple|reconstructed]], and the majority of the Order relocated there. Rebuilding the formal knighting hall, the Council once more continued the formal ceremony of the Old Order.<ref name="TJP" />

==Formal passages of the knighting ceremony==
[[File:DubTheeIDoJedi-CW21.jpg|thumb|200px|Anakin Skywalker having his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Padawan braid/Legends|braid]] cut off by Yoda during his Knighting ceremony.|alt="(Your Name) By the right of the council, By the will of the force dub thee I do, Jedi. Knight of the Republic."]]
At each formal ceremony, the Grand Master recited the same ancient words when knighting each Padawan. The formal opening of the ceremony welcomed the participating Masters, and focused their minds on why they were there.<ref name="TJP" />

:''"We are all Jedi. The Force speaks through us. Through our actions, the Force proclaims itself and what is real. Today we are here to acknowledge what the Force has proclaimed."''<ref name="TJP" />

With that said, the Grand Master would call the Padawan by name and bring their lightsaber down above each of the kneeling student's shoulders.<ref name="TJP" />

:''"By the right of the Council, by the will of the Force, I dub thee Jedi, Knight of the Republic."''<ref name="TJP" />

With the ceremony complete, the Knight would take up their lightsaber and exit the chamber in silence, signaling the end of the ritual.<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 21" />
